about: Style test, round one (owner, 2026-10-14): three Fifteen Days frames in 23 styles, the same subject and seed per frame so only the style changes. Every frame subject and the four new style prompts are model-drafted test prompts, labelled, never published; the winning style is rewritten in the owner's words before anything is published. Prompts describe qualities; no artist or studio is named. Characters and places from content/snowmoon/designs (descriptors).

styles.name: Clear-line techno
styles.prompt: Clear-line science fiction comic art: clean, even, unbroken ink outlines of uniform weight, no hatching and no cross-hatching, flat areas of color with only subtle washes, dense intricate technology designed into the architecture and objects (cables, vents, panels, antennas, small machines) all drawn with the same clean even line, precise architectural detail, deep space and distant megastructures, calm pastel skies, a European comic album look, no text, no lettering, no writing, no logos, no numbers.

styles.name: Clear-line techno, vivid
styles.prompt: Clear-line science fiction comic art: clean, even, unbroken ink outlines of uniform weight, no hatching, bold flat saturated colors with strong contrast and hard-edged cel-shaded shadows, dense intricate technology designed into the architecture and objects (cables, vents, panels, antennas, small machines) all drawn with the same clean line, precise architectural detail, deep space and distant megastructures, vivid skies, a European comic album look, no text, no lettering, no writing, no logos, no numbers.

styles.name: Techno vistas
styles.prompt: Detailed science fiction comic art: precise fine uniform linework, rich mechanical and architectural detail kept to the middle and far distance, vast airy compositions with big pastel skies and enormous elegant megastructures on the horizon, cel-shaded flat color with soft hard-edged shadows, clean and bright and hopeful, cinematic wide-angle perspective, no text, no lettering, no writing, no logos, no numbers.

styles.name: Clear-line future
styles.prompt: Clear-line science fiction comic art: clean, even, unbroken ink outlines of uniform weight, no hatching and no cross-hatching, flat areas of color with only subtle watercolor washes, precise architectural detail, vast airy compositions with deep space and distant megastructures, elegant strange machines and vehicles, calm pastel skies, a European comic album look, no text, no lettering, no writing, no logos, no numbers.

styles.name: Day-glo privacy noir
styles.prompt: Bold graphic comic art: confident clean black linework, flat pure saturated color with no gradients, a vivid palette of pure cyan, magenta and bright yellow against deep violet shadows, strong graphic shapes and silhouettes, dramatic noir camera angles but bright day-glo color, hoods, masks and disguises as a visual motif, no text, no lettering, no writing, no logos, no numbers.

styles.name: Dense techno
styles.prompt: Hyper-detailed science fiction comic art: precise fine linework, obsessive mechanical and architectural detail with cables, vents, panels and small machines, dense layered cityscapes, cel-shaded flat color with hard-edged shadows, cinematic wide-angle perspective, clean and bright rather than grim, no text, no lettering, no writing, no logos, no numbers.

styles.name: Ink-wash painterly
styles.prompt: Painted science fiction graphic novel art: loose expressive brush-ink lines, layered translucent watercolor washes, dramatic directional light and atmospheric haze, dense intricate futuristic technology and architecture rendered in fine detail, cinematic composition, luminous glows, no text, no lettering, no writing, no logos, no numbers.

styles.name: Solarpunk Art Nouveau
styles.prompt: Art Nouveau solarpunk illustration: flowing whiplash curves and botanical ornament, decorative framing of vines and leaves, poster-like flat color with fine elegant line, warm sunlit golden palette with greens and turquoise, harmonious high-tech organic architecture with solar glass, living walls and vertical gardens, elegant flowing garments, no text, no lettering, no writing, no logos, no numbers.

styles.name: Ink and watercolor
styles.prompt: Storybook illustration, fine ink linework with soft watercolor washes, gentle natural light, slightly stylized proportions, no text, no lettering, no writing, no logos, no numbers.

styles.name: Fork 1: Core
styles.prompt: Detailed science fiction comic art: precise fine uniform linework, rich mechanical and architectural detail where the scene has it, cel-shaded flat color with soft hard-edged shadows, clean and bright, clear readable faces and hands, framing chosen to suit the moment, from wide views to close-ups.

styles.name: Fork 2: Warm light
styles.prompt: Detailed science fiction comic art: precise fine uniform linework, rich mechanical and architectural detail, cel-shaded flat color with soft hard-edged shadows, warm low golden light with long soft shadows, gentle warm palette, clear readable faces and hands.

styles.name: Fork 3: Heavier line
styles.prompt: Detailed science fiction comic art: bold confident outer contours with fine inner linework, figures that stand out clearly from the background, rich mechanical and architectural detail, cel-shaded flat color with soft hard-edged shadows, clean and bright, clear readable faces and hands.

styles.name: Fork 4: Night
styles.prompt: Detailed science fiction comic art: precise fine uniform linework, cel-shaded flat color, deep blue and violet night with glowing practical lights, pools of warm and cool light on faces and surfaces, crisp silhouettes, rich mechanical detail picked out by the lights, clear readable faces and hands.

styles.name: Fork 5: Quiet
styles.prompt: Detailed science fiction comic art: precise fine uniform linework, restrained cel-shaded color in muted soft tones, simple uncluttered backgrounds with plenty of empty space, soft natural light, the focus on faces, hands and posture, calm and intimate.

styles.name: Fork 6: Printed
styles.prompt: Detailed science fiction comic art: precise fine uniform linework, cel-shaded flat color with soft hard-edged shadows, a subtle printed-paper texture with fine halftone dots in the shadows and slightly offset color, rich mechanical and architectural detail, clear readable faces and hands.

styles.name: Painted storyboard
styles.prompt: Painted film storyboard art: loose confident gouache brushwork, simple bold shapes and strong contrast between light and dark, limited palette per scene, cinematic framing like a camera shot, figures drawn for clear acting and gesture, background detail only where it matters.

styles.name: Privacy noir, in daylight
styles.prompt: Graphic comic art about secrecy: clean confident black linework, flat color, strong silhouettes, hooded robes and face covers as a recurring shape, dramatic noir framing through doorways, curtains and reflections, but daylight colour: deep purple, grey, moss green and warm stone, with sharp highlights.

styles.name: Cutaway sections
styles.prompt: Architectural cutaway illustration: a cross-section view showing the inside and the outside of the place at once, above and below ground, rooms, tunnels and stairways visible, precise fine linework, flat soft color, small figures for scale, clean and easy to read.

styles.name: Minpentai broadcast
styles.prompt: Glowing 3D game-world rendering: a vast dark playing field of luminous grid cells, structures and moving pieces made of light, each player's pieces in their own bright color, dramatic camera flythrough angles, a sense of huge scale, clean and abstract, as seen by a stadium audience.

styles.name: Graphic-novel ink, flat colour
styles.source: model-drafted for this test (owner's four directions, 2026-10-14)
styles.prompt: Graphic novel art: confident brush-and-pen black ink with varied line weight and solid spotted blacks, flat unshaded colour fills in a restrained palette, strong clear shapes, expressive faces and hands, generous negative space.

styles.name: Muted cinematic, film grain
styles.source: model-drafted for this test (owner's four directions, 2026-10-14)
styles.prompt: Muted cinematic illustration with the look of a still from a film: soft natural light, desaturated colour with gentle warm and cool contrast, shallow depth of field, fine visible film grain, quiet and observed, faces lit softly, framed like a camera shot.

styles.name: Limited-palette screen print
styles.source: model-drafted for this test (owner's four directions, 2026-10-14)
styles.prompt: Limited-palette screen print: three to four flat ink colours layered with slight misregistration, bold simplified shapes, visible paper texture, halftone-free solid areas, crisp edges, warm off-white paper showing through.

styles.name: Woodblock
styles.source: model-drafted for this test (owner's four directions, 2026-10-14)
styles.prompt: Woodblock print illustration: carved outlines with tapering strokes, flat areas of colour with soft wood-grain texture and gentle gradations, decorative patterns in cloth and foliage, calm composition, muted natural pigments on handmade paper.
